mostWorthwhile.text: Filtering the blood and then recovering useful substances was most worthwhile. It explained why the kidney cannot just filter out waste in one step.

leastWorthwhile.text: Attaching the ureters and bladder was clear but felt more like straightforward assembly than a meaningful choice.

surprise.text: I was surprised that glucose passes through the filter along with wastes and has to be taken back.

arbitrary.text: Combining the remaining kidney fluid with the whole kidney pair felt a little abstract, though the pictures gave me a reason to try it.

continue.text: I would continue for another chapter: seeing filtering and recovery as connected steps was interesting, and I would like to see another body process explained that way.
